text:
Maria L: Heads-up: prepping internal release note + short teaser for tomorrow's micro-rollout. Need signoff on embargo and canary cohort. Draft below. Target change window: 02:00–04:00 UTC. Please reply with +1 or edits.

DeployBot: Scheduled deploy v1.23.0 -> staging. Canary plan: 5% traffic in eu-west-1, 30m steady-state probe. Will post status updates.

Chris K: +1 timing. Recommend pin inference model to `model-x@1.23.0-quant` for latency consistency. Also propose rollback trigger: (>=5% 5xx) or (p50 latency increase >40%).

Leo R: FYI legal asked for a sentence about telemetry retention in external comms. For internal notes ok to mention "no user data shipped" if correct.

Paige S: Draft internal blurb below — please tweak microcopy. Also tagging @oncall for standby.

Maria L: (draft) "Tomorrow 02:00–04:00 UTC we'll perform a micro-rollout for v1.23.0. Canary at 5% (eu-west-1) with automatic ramp to 25% pending no regression. Pinned model: model-x@1.23.0-quant. Expected user impact: none; fallback to model-x@1.22.3 if errors exceed thresholds. Oncall: Leo R. Please DM me any major concerns by EOD." 

Chris K: can we add explicit rollback cmd (for ops): `deploy rollback service/inference --to model-x@1.22.3 --force` and include runbook link: https://go/runbooks/rollbacks

Leo R: I'm ok to be oncall standby for the window. I'll set a watch on the canary dashboard and have 30m blocks for response. If we hit rollback triggers I'll execute the rollback and post the incident thread.

DeployBot: Canary started -> eu-west-1 5% at 02:10 UTC. Health checks passing. Monitoring: canary.health, infra.logs

Paige S: minor copy tweak accepted. Also please avoid external blast until legal vs. privacy confirms language. We'll hold the public note until Leo confirms no telemetry issues.

Maria L: thanks. Final ask: ops, please pin model and set autoscale cap to +10% for the window. Reply here when done. :thumbsup:
